creators.name: Ian Curtis
creators.role: Designer & creative technologist (World Labs; formerly Niantic / 8th Wall)
creators.bio: Architecture-trained designer who prototypes AR in public on X: WebAR portals, location-anchored scenes, and, lately, generated Gaussian-splat worlds placed in real rooms.
creators.why: Ships a new spatial experiment almost every week and shows exactly how it was built — a living notebook of what AR can do next.

works.title: Tap to launch orbs into a generated world
works.description: A WebAR scene built from a World Labs Gaussian splat of his room; tapping the phone fires glowing orbs that fly through the space.
works.idea_zh: 把 AI 生成的 3D 世界叠在真实房间里，点一下就向其中发射光球。

works.title: Living room redesign as WebAR splat
works.description: A generated interior redesign of his living room rendered as a Gaussian splat and aligned in WebAR, so he can walk through the future room on his phone.
works.idea_zh: 把 AI 设计的新客厅以 1:1 叠在旧客厅上，用手机走进“未来的房间”。

works.title: Touching grass: two-prompt WebAR
works.description: An outdoor WebAR prototype with SLAM tracking, built with two prompts to an AI coding model, where he drags virtual objects across real grass.
works.idea_zh: 用两句 prompt 生成一个户外 WebAR 原型：AI 写代码，人直接在草地上摆弄虚拟物体。

works.title: Splat worlds as AR camera stand-ins
works.description: Generated 3DGS environments act as a spatial reference for directing real-time AR camera moves; the capture is then restyled by a video model.
works.idea_zh: 用 AR 手机当“虚拟摄影机”，在生成的 3D 场景里走位拍镜头，再交给视频模型出成片。

works.title: A 20-million-splat San Francisco on the table
works.description: A 20M-splat scan of San Francisco runs on a phone in WebAR; moving the phone closer zooms into individual streets.
works.idea_zh: 把整座旧金山缩成桌上模型，手机靠近就钻进街道。

works.title: Shrunk to action-figure size on the coffee table
works.description: In mixed reality he shrinks himself to action-figure scale and explores a tiny generated world sitting on his living-room coffee table.
works.idea_zh: 把自己缩小成手办大小，在茶几上的迷你世界里探险。

works.title: A picture frame that is a window
works.description: A WebXR picture frame on the office wall that shows a persistent generated 3D world behind it, like a window into another place.
works.idea_zh: 墙上挂一个“相框”，里面其实是通往另一个 3D 世界的窗户。

works.title: Coit Tower in the living room
works.description: A 40M-splat scan of San Francisco's Coit Tower placed in his living room, running fully on-device on Quest 3 through WebXR.
works.idea_zh: 把一座真实地标的超大扫描模型搬进客厅，在头显里绕着看。

works.title: Gaussian splat capture in Quest mixed reality
works.description: A friend's Gaussian splat capture viewed in Quest passthrough MR via WebXR and Spark level-of-detail streaming.
works.idea_zh: 把真实场景的扫描放进 MR 里，和现实并排对照。

works.title: Off-axis projection with face tracking
works.description: A head-coupled perspective demo: MediaPipe tracks the viewer's face so a 3D scanned shoe on a flat screen shifts perspective like a window.
works.idea_zh: 用摄像头追踪人脸，让普通屏幕变成有纵深的“窗口”，头动画面跟着变。

works.title: Off-axis window into a generated world
works.description: Blender layout turned into a detailed World Labs splat, viewed through a face-tracked off-axis projection so the monitor becomes a window.
works.idea_zh: 先用简单体块搭场景，再用 AI 生成细节，最后用人脸追踪把屏幕变成通往世界的窗。

works.title: A pocket holodeck in WebAR
works.description: Gaussian splats of about 5 MB each, generated from single images, placed around him in web AR like a miniature holodeck.
works.idea_zh: 每个 AI 生成的场景只有 5MB，放在身边就是随身全息甲板。

works.title: Game Boy graphics in real life
works.description: A living-room test that brings chunky Game Boy-style graphics into the real room.
works.idea_zh: 把 Game Boy 像素画风搬进真实客厅。

works.title: Redesigned living room, 1.5 MB per splat
works.description: Nano Banana image → World Labs world → WebAR: several living-room redesigns as tiny .spz splats he can switch between in place.
works.idea_zh: 在原地切换多套 AI 生成的客厅设计方案。

works.title: Photo to WebAR world in real time
works.description: A single photo becomes a 5 MB Gaussian splat scene that runs in real time as a WebAR experience.
works.idea_zh: 一张照片变成可以走进去的 AR 场景。

works.title: Desk-side web AR experiment
works.description: A quick web AR sketch built at his desk.
works.idea_zh: 桌面上的即兴 WebAR 小实验。

works.title: Morning stroll into a portal
works.description: Walking through a doorway-sized portal into a World Labs-generated environment.
works.idea_zh: 走进一扇门，门后是 AI 生成的世界。

works.title: Step into a persistent redesign, 1:1
works.description: Gemini designs a new living room, World Labs generates it in 3D, and VPS localizes it to his real room at 1:1 scale so he can step into it.
works.idea_zh: AI 设计 + AI 生成 + 定位对齐：在自己家里 1:1 走进重新设计的客厅。

works.title: Location-triggered AR scene
works.description: An older location-based AR experience: arrive at the spot, open the experience, and the scene comes to life in place.
works.idea_zh: 走到特定地点，AR 故事才会出现。

works.title: Mixed Reality Map of San Francisco
works.description: A web app for discovering location-based AR across San Francisco: open it on a phone, tap a pin, and launch the AR on the spot with no download.
works.idea_zh: 一张城市地图，点地图上的针就在原地打开 AR。

works.title: Midjourney → splat → AR
works.description: A generated image turned into an 8 MB Gaussian splat and viewed in web AR.
works.idea_zh: 从一张 AI 图片到可以站进去的 AR 场景。

works.title: AI wayfinding companion (Spatial 1)
works.description: A 3D-printed wearable that sees what you see, localizes with VPS, and speaks directions with Gemini and ElevenLabs.
works.idea_zh: 一个挂在胸前、能看路并说话的 AI 导航伙伴。

works.title: three.js in real life
works.description: A three.js scene pulled off the screen and placed in the physical world with AR.
works.idea_zh: 把网页 3D 引擎的效果搬到现实里。

works.title: Augmented Reality Portal
works.description: A walk-in web AR portal that anyone can try from a link.
works.idea_zh: 一个打开链接就能走进去的 AR 传送门。

works.title: VPS-anchored WebAR demo
works.description: A real-time WebAR experience anchored to a specific real-world location with a visual positioning system.
works.idea_zh: 内容钉在真实地点上，谁来都看到同一个位置的同一个东西。

works.title: Niantic Spatial launch + WebAR portal
works.description: Brand and product vision for Niantic Spatial's debut, including a working WebAR portal released with the launch film.
works.idea_zh: 把公司发布会本身做成一个可以走进去的 WebAR 传送门。

works.title: Scaniverse Gaussian splat map
works.description: UX for browsing Gaussian-splat captures of real places on a map, then jumping from map to 3D to AR views.
works.idea_zh: 在地图上浏览全世界人们扫描的真实地点，再一键放进 AR。

works.title: 8th Wall hand tracking UX
works.description: Gesture patterns, guidelines and demos for hand-tracked interaction in browser-based AR.
works.idea_zh: 在网页 AR 里用手直接抓取、捏合虚拟物体的交互规范。

works.title: Wol: AI owl guide to the redwoods
works.description: An AR owl you talk to about the redwood forest ecosystem, running on phones and MR headsets from one web build.
works.idea_zh: 和一只 AR 猫头鹰对话，让它带你认识红杉林。

works.title: 8th Wall moon portal
works.description: Showcase WebAR portal to the moon, built to demonstrate the R17 engine's portal rendering.
works.idea_zh: 在街上打开一个通往月球的门。

works.title: Niantic Studio spatial anchoring
works.description: Developer workflow and demos for placing AR at real-world locations with VPS, including physics-driven content anchored to places.
works.idea_zh: 在编辑器里选一个真实地点，把 AR 内容精确钉上去。

works.title: Simulon AR VFX
works.description: Blender physics simulations composited into real locations using Simulon's AR capture and real-world lighting.
works.idea_zh: 用手机 AR 在现场“拍”特效，光照与真实环境一致。

works.title: Tetris in WebAR, written by ChatGPT
works.description: A playable Tetris board floating in the room, with the WebAR code generated by ChatGPT.
works.idea_zh: 让 AI 写代码，把俄罗斯方块立在客厅里玩。

works.title: Augmented Reality 2023 (compilation)
works.description: A reel of his favourite real-time WebAR experiences built during 2023.
works.idea_zh: 一年的 WebAR 实验合集：适合当作“AR 能做什么”的速览。

works.title: Candy cane tower vs. robot
works.description: He stacks a physics-driven candy-cane tower on the floor in WebAR, and a small virtual robot knocks it down.
works.idea_zh: 在地板上搭一座会倒的虚拟糖果塔，再放一个捣蛋机器人。

works.title: Resize your present with a photo scan
works.description: A real gift is photo-scanned into a 3D model and re-imported into AR, where it can be scaled up or down.
works.idea_zh: 把真实礼物扫描成 3D 模型，再在 AR 里随意放大缩小。

works.title: A robot that tidies up ornaments
works.description: A virtual robot rolls around the real floor collecting fallen Christmas ornaments in WebAR.
works.idea_zh: 一个在真实地板上帮你收拾圣诞装饰的虚拟机器人。
